fact: The Government Cloud Strategy 2023-2027 states government recently deployed a Tier-2 data centre managed by Gamtel (and elsewhere a Tier 3 one), with a Tier-4 centre contemplated, and asks cloud providers to prove failover of key components to a secondary data centre with documented DR procedures.
title: Government Cloud Strategy 2023 - 2027 The Gambia
publisher: Ministry of Communications and Digital Economy (The Gambia)
